{{Quote|The 88th Armor battalion is on its way. The 301st Infantry is being rotated back to Coruscant.|General Callan Grayne|<ref name="The Price of Victory" />}}
The '''88th Armor''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that served during the early days of the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|2}}</ref> the [[301st Infantry]] unit was rotated off of the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|embattled]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after aiding the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|recovering]] the plans for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]]. While the 301st was sent back to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the 88th Armor was assigned to Hoth in their place by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Callan Grayne]].<ref name="The Price of Victory" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 88th Armor was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Jedi Knight mission "The Price of Victory."<ref name="The Price of Victory" />
